notes: Model probabilities are the ClubElo ordered-logit forecasts produced before kick-off, as reported in the session that built apps/espn/club_elo.py.
Bologna-Sassuolo prices were supplied by the account holder from their own book.

The other three books are the pre-match 1X2 prices reported by Italian odds aggregators for the same fixtures; they are a single snapshot, not a best-price shop across books, so the margins here are the ordinary retail 4-7% rather than a Pinnacle-grade 2.9%.
Results are final scores confirmed against ANSA and match-report sources.
Only the 15:00 and 20:45 kick-offs of this round are on the card; matches for which no price snapshot could be recovered are absent rather than invented.
